title: Minified route cost snapshot: MVP scoping and acceptance criteria
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: PRD excerpt: Deliver a lightweight route-level cost snapshot card for the Redwood Console insights view that gives product teams a quick, scannable summary for each route without loading full cost explorer pages. Goal is to reduce time-to-insight for customers and provide a graceful fallback when full telemetry is expensive. This ticket scopes MVP cuts: remove deep per-token breakdown, delay per-inference trace embedding, and stub advanced filter controls. MVP should ship an unintrusive card in the routes list and a compact modal with 24h aggregates and a link to full cost explorer.
acceptance_criteria: Card shows for each route in the Routes table: 24h estimate of token cost, median latency, 95th latency, request count (last 24h)
Numbers display delta vs previous 24h (arrow + percent) when available; show 'insufficient data' when <50 requests
Card render time on the Console list page must be <200ms p95 added overhead for user-visible navigation
Clicking metric opens compact modal with: trend sparkline (24h), top contributor model (string), and a button 'Open cost explorer' that navigates to the detailed cost page
Tracing deep-dive is NOT included in MVP; instead include a contextual link 'Open trace (sampled)' only when trace is available and no inline trace viewer is shipped
Feature respects RBAC: users without billing read permission must see 'Restricted' label and a CTA to request access
Acceptance tests: automated e2e test that seeds synthetic telemetry and asserts card numbers, UI tests for 'insufficient data' state, performance test to validate <200ms overhead
decisions: Cut deep per-token stacked breakdown from MVP due to cost and cardinality concerns across routes; will revisit after instrument-level sampling is in place.
Omit in-page trace inspector for GA; provide a sampled trace link that routes to existing traces page to preserve reliability and reduce frontend scope.
Default sampling threshold: only show sampled-trace link when a sampled trace exists in the last 24h for that route to avoid dead links.
Use existing metrics API endpoints rather than implementing new aggregation service for MVP; create follow-up to evaluate pre-aggregated rollups if cost grows.
engineering_notes: Backend: reuse /v1/metrics/routes/summary with query params {window:24h} and accept slight added latency; add optional ?compact=true to reduce payload size.
Frontend: implement lightweight card component, avoid loading Charting library for list view; use sparkline SVG microchart built in-house.
Performance trade-off: to hit <200ms p95 we will batch metrics fetches per page and fall back to stale cache if RPCs exceed budget.
Estimate: 3 backend days to add compact endpoint flag + caching; 4 frontend days for UI and e2e tests; 1 day for rollout automation and feature flag gating.
design_feedback: Design reviewed v1 mock: recommended removing per-route actions from card to reduce visual noise; action surface limited to modal CTA.
Accessibility: ensure color-blind safe deltas and text alternatives for icons; confirm keyboard navigation for modal open/close.
UX suggestion: use muted tone and microcopy 'Estimate' vs 'Exact' to set expectation about sampling and approximation.
dependencies: PM-703900 (launch gating: telemetry sampling policy decision)
